It's essential to note that these changes can be highly individualized and dependent on personal experiences, cultural context, and individual values. However, for many people, living through Ramadan and similar experiences can indeed lead to a reevaluation of what they value most in life. In your case, having gone through this experience every year, you may have developed a unique perspective on what truly matters to you.
